title: [BUG] misidentified command for approval.
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [X] Anthropic API - [ ] AWS Bedrock - [ ] Google Vertex AI - [ ] Other: - Claude CLI version: 0.2.78 (Claude Code) - Operating System: MacOS 14.3 - Terminal: Ghostty ## Bug Description Claude proposed that I allow "find commands" when the actual command it was running was shell command starting with rm -rf. (The actual command it's running is totally reasonable, but there's no find invocation in the list of commands it's running) ## Steps to Reproduce ...sadly, I have no idea. Claude was deep into tool calls. ## Expected Behavior I expected it to propose the command it was actually running. ## Actual Behavior A little bit of misdirection.
author: obra
